name: CapybaraHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A DPO finetune of teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B (LoRA, TRL, 3 epochs on argilla/dpo-mix-7k), merged to full 7.242B weights - same config.json and tensor set as the base. Not a new base model. Recorded because the card prints the base and this model as two rows of one table on the same tests: AGIEval 43.8 vs 42.75, GPT4All 73.35 vs 72.99, TruthfulQA 57.07 vs 52.99, Bigbench 42.44 vs 40.94, MTBench second turn 7.5625 vs 7.2875, MTBench avg 7.903 vs 7.769, Nous avg 54.16 vs 52.42. It does lose MTBench first turn to the base (8.24375 vs 8.25) and TruthfulQA to Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 (66.82), which is not its base. The separate Open LLM Leaderboard block on the same card (ARC 65.78, HellaSwag 85.45, MMLU 63.13, GSM8k 59.29) is absolute, with no base column, so those rows are not recorded. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-01-30.
